status: Training-side exploratory endpoint and split review; not a main-run configuration
primary_user_objective: Reach all observed chunks predicted ONB-positive at the lowest measured heat-flux stage; q100 and source-day g100
evaluation: Pooled WAV-disjoint training OOF, 1620 chunks, 45 chunks per source WAV
noise_policy: clean_only; minus20 inputs are fixed clean-fit transfer diagnostics
split_prototype: Within each day, sort source WAVs by heat flux; distribute successive rank blocks of 3 one per held-out fold; reject label-only allocations placing all near-ONB WAVs in one fold if at least 2 exist

known_wav_time_block_alternative.status: Split feasibility audit only; no model trained and no main setting changed
known_wav_time_block_alternative.purpose: Align internal selection with known-source-WAV unused-chunk scope and retain all measured stages
known_wav_time_block_alternative.limitations: A chosen gap does not prove temporal independence; this is not unknown-WAV validation

near_onb_definition_for_split_audit: 0.9 <= heat_flux/source_day_ONB <= 1.1; support audit only, not primary accuracy objective

nested_selection.partitions: Three source-WAV folds inside each outer training-side OOF fit; split policy applies at both levels
nested_selection.q100_then_fp: Illustrative lexicographic (worst source-day g100, mean g100, pooled FP count, RMSE), matching the stated early all-positive endpoint priority; report false alarms separately
nested_selection.fp_then_q100: Illustrative lexicographic (pooled FP count, worst source-day g100, mean g100, RMSE), chosen only on inner clean OOF; no user-approved numeric FP tolerance is assumed
nested_selection.unreachable_q100: positive infinity for ranking; missing for reporting

fixed_features: Same 10 acoustic band/shape features as the 2026-10-04 SVR; no true heat flux, source day, WAV identifier or chunk index in prediction inputs
limitations: A single independent source WAV per day/stage cannot be simultaneously fit and held out while preserving WAV separation
Prototype ensures pooled near-ONB fit coverage only when group multiplicity allows it; not day-specific ONB coverage in every fold
Early endpoint improvement can accompany false alarms; neither the candidate nor the illustrative objective is automatically adopted
Shared 10-feature pilots do not evaluate all representations of any model family
Noise results already informed candidate research; transfer evaluation is exploratory, not pristine confirmation
Pooled cross-fitted q100 is not an endpoint of a single final model or a population-level 100 percent guarantee
